sahneler.metin: Floodwater broke through levees across the American Midwest.
For months, towns and farms went underwater, and fifty people died.
Months of rain filled the Mississippi and Missouri.
Rivers stayed at record levels for weeks.
Nearly all private farm levees on the Missouri were overtopped or destroyed.
One man was accused of removing sandbags from a levee on purpose.
The breach flooded thousands of acres.
It reshaped how America handles floodplains.
